identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of PCI-32765 (Ibrutinib) in Combination With Either Bendamustine and Rituximab or Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, and Prednisone in Participants With Previously Treated Indolent Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase 3 Study of the Bruton's Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor, PCI-32765 (Ibrutinib), in Combination With Either Bendamustine and Rituximab (BR) or Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, and Prednisone (R-CHOP) in Subjects With Previously Treated Indolent Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma (iNHL)

armGroups.label: Treatment Arm A
armGroups.description: Treatment Arm A = background immune-chemotherapy (bendamustine and rituximab \[BR\] or rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, and prednisone \[R-CHOP\]) for 6 cycles + placebo.

armGroups.label: Treatment Arm B
armGroups.description: Treatment Arm B = background immune-chemotherapy (BR or R-CHOP) for 6 cycles + PCI-32765 (Ibrutinib).

interventions.name: Bendamustine
interventions.description: 90 milligram per meter square (mg/m\^2) administered intravenously on Days 1 to 2 of Cycles 1 to 6.

interventions.name: Rituximab
interventions.description: 375 mg/m\^2 administered intravenously on Day 1 of Cycles 1 to 6.

interventions.name: Cyclophosphamide
interventions.description: 750 mg/m\^2 administered intravenously on Day 1 of Cycles 1 to 6.

interventions.name: Doxorubicin
interventions.description: 50 mg/m\^2 administered intravenously on Day 1 of Cycles 1 to 6.

interventions.name: Vincristine
interventions.description: 1.4 mg/m\^2 (maximum total 2 mg) administered intravenously on Day 1 of Cycles 1 to 6.

interventions.name: Prednisone
interventions.description: 100 mg administered orally on Days 1 to 5 of Cycles 1 to 6.

interventions.name: PCI-32765 (Ibrutinib)
interventions.description: 560 mg (4\*140 mg) capsules administered orally once daily, continuously starting on Cycle 1, Day 1.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo (4 capsules) matched to ibrutinib administered orally once daily, continuously starting on Cycle 1, Day 1.
